invariants.name: no literal colours in components
invariants.diagnosis: Every colour the app paints is a token in design/tokens.json, generated into frontend/src/styles/tokens.css and exposed as bg-canvas, text-fg-muted, border-line, text-accent and so on. A literal hex, an rgb() or one of Tailwind's own palette names is a colour defined somewhere other than the source: it ignores the theme, ignores the chapter accent, and the next token change leaves it behind. A colour the set does not name is a token to add, never a literal to inline (Kollektiv's rule, adopted here). Legitimate exception: none in these paths. The generated tokens.css is outside the grep on purpose, since it is where the literals are supposed to be.

invariants.name: no hand-written design values
invariants.diagnosis: Letter-spacing, the hover lift, icon sizes and the opacity stops of the scrims and the pending-art grid are tokens in design/tokens.json (type.tracking, effect, layout.icon), read as tracking-control, brightness-(--effect-hover-brightness), size-(--layout-icon-md) and var(--scrim-edge). An arbitrary tracking-[0.08em] or a color-mix() with a literal percentage is the same value with no single place to change it, and the app and the download site drift. A value the tokens do not name is one to add there. The generated tokens.css is excluded: it is where the values are supposed to be.

invariants.name: no arbitrary pixel text sizes
invariants.diagnosis: The type scale is design/tokens.json's type.size, generated as text-2xs through text-display. An inlined text-[13px] is the same value with no single place to change it. A size the scale does not name is a value to add there.

invariants.name: shell never sees a command string
invariants.diagnosis: Prism is called with an argument array, never through a shell, so a crafted instance id or server address cannot become a second command (docs/HANDOFF.md section 6, agent_docs/SECURITY_CHECKLIST.md S4). A match here is a shell being invoked with something as its script. Legitimate exception: none.

invariants.name: no discarded errors
invariants.diagnosis: An error in the second return position discarded as `x, _ := f()` is a failure nobody hears about. Handle it where it happens, or say why the discard is right in a trailing `//nolint:errcheck // reason` on the same line. The comma-ok form of a type assertion (`v, _ := x.(T)`) is idiomatic and excluded by the lookahead.

invariants.name: icons come from one module
invariants.diagnosis: frontend/src/lib/icons.ts is the only module that imports lucide-react, so the icon set is swappable from one file and the entry chunk pays only for what it re-exports. ESLint enforces the same rule in eslint.config.js; this is the copy that runs where ESLint does not.

invariants.name: no em dashes in published copy
invariants.diagnosis: Nothing the user reads carries an em dash: use a comma, a colon, a middle dot or two sentences. The rule is the Kapitel Kapital wiki's and the Kollektiv suite's alike, and this repo extends it to its own docs. Not covered: docs/HANDOFF.md, which is the brief as it was received, and the files vendored from Kollektiv, which are that repo's to write. Pull request titles and bodies are checked by pr-copy.yml.

generated.diagnosis: A non-empty diff means one of the three generated token files was hand-edited, or design/tokens.json changed without regenerating. Both are bugs: the next run reverts the edit, and the CSS, TypeScript and Go copies of a value stop agreeing. Regenerate and commit all three with the token change.
